name: How does the condition of the inherited property affect its sale in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: How does the condition of the inherited property affect its sale in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: The condition of an inherited property significantly impacts its market appeal and sale price, particularly in areas like South Florida where buyers often seek move-in ready homes. A property needing substantial repairs may attract investors or cash buyers looking for a discount, while a well-maintained home will appeal to a broader range of traditional buyers, potentially fetching a higher price. Kelby Contreras can advise on cost-effective improvements that maximize return in the local market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Property condition directly affects market appeal and sale price, with well-maintained homes often selling for more to traditional buyers.
